cards.prompt: Se avessi tempo, viaggerei di più.
cards.answer: If I had time, I'd travel more.

cards.answer: If I were you, I'd accept.

cards.prompt: Se vincessi alla lotteria, smetterei di lavorare.
cards.answer: If I won the lottery, I'd stop working.

If it rains, we'll stay home.
cards.notes: For real possibilities, plain present tense is fine.
